description: Fastest cited answer to one question across selected studies ("why did customers churn?"). For multi-turn follow-ups with clickable quote cards use chat_research_session. Uses indexed research across selected accessible studies. Returns generated statements with numbered citations to canonical content IDs, plus source details and index status. Use search_research to inspect the underlying records.

filters.description: Selected study IDs and optional limits on research dates and content types.

content_types.description: Limit matches to these types of indexed research records.

research_date_from.description: Earliest research date to include, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

research_date_to.description: Latest research date to include, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

study_ids.description: One to 20 accessible study UUIDs to search.

organization_id.description: Organization for this operation and billing. Use list_organizations to choose an active membership.

question.description: Research question to answer using evidence from the selected studies.

name: answer_research

result.description: Generated research answer with validated citations and source records.

title: Answer Research
